question: Should the dashboard agent-status widget land as a sessions.list-backed builtin now, or should this issue wait for the broader sessions.activity.* Gateway activity contract before being considered solved?
rationale: The user-facing dashboard request is clear, but the permanent source of truth for current task, progress, awaiting input, and cross-agent activity is a product/API sequencing choice that automation cannot safely choose.

options.title: Keep Staged Dashboard Builtin
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate solution while requiring its review, proof, storage, dependency, and security blockers to clear before closing this issue.

options.title: Wait For Activity Contract
options.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 settles a richer Gateway-owned activity model, then implement the widget against that contract.

options.title: Fold Into Roadmap Tracker
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 own sequencing, but only after preserving this issue's unique status-widget requirements there.

recommendation.title: Keep Staged Dashboard Builtin
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate solution while requiring its review, proof, storage, dependency, and security blockers to clear before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current routing signal for the Control UI plugin-tab/product seam that the dashboard widget would use.
